# Metrics reference

The admin listener serves Prometheus metrics on `/metrics`. This table is the gateway's
complete metric catalog (`metrics.Catalog()`), in catalog order. Recording a name that is
not in the catalog, under a different type, or with a different label set is reported as
`metrics_drift` on the admin `/healthz` (see [health.md](health.md)).

A row marked **declared, not emitted** is part of the contract but no code path records
it yet: it does not appear on `/metrics`, and recording it is itself a drift entry.

Label values are bounded: every metric is capped at a fixed number of series, and no
metric carries a caller IP except `gateway_watched_ip_rejected_total`, whose `ip` label
is the configured `observability.watch_ips` entry rather than the observed address.

| Metric | Type | Labels | Status | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gateway_trigger_total` | counter | `repo`, `workflow`, `status` | emitted | Trigger requests that reached target validation, by trigger_outcome outcome_status. NOT an HTTP code. |
| `gateway_trigger_duration_seconds` | histogram | `repo`, `workflow` | emitted | End-to-end gateway handling time for a trigger request. |
| `gateway_idempotency_replay_total` | counter | — | emitted | Requests answered from a cached idempotent response. |
| `gateway_idempotency_conflict_total` | counter | — | emitted | 409 idempotency_conflict: same key, different body or path. |
| `gateway_upstream_errors_total` | counter | `upstream_status` | emitted | Dispatch calls that failed upstream, by the GitHub status (0 when there was no response). |
| `gateway_caller_requests_total` | counter | `caller` | emitted | Authenticated trigger requests per caller. |
| `gateway_github_rate_remaining` | gauge | `bucket` | emitted | GitHub quota remaining per quota bucket. 'app' is the App JWT bucket. |
| `gateway_github_rate_reset_timestamp` | gauge | `bucket` | emitted | Unix timestamp at which the quota bucket resets. |
| `gateway_sqlite_write_duration_seconds` | histogram | `table` | emitted | Duration of a durable write, by the table it targets. |
| `gateway_uptime_seconds` | gauge | — | emitted | Seconds since the gateway process started. |
| `gateway_inventory_coverage_gap_pct` | gauge | — | emitted | Coverage gap percentage. Never reaches zero; the structural half is by design. |
| `gateway_inventory_coverage_unknown_pct` | gauge | — | emitted | Unknown-coverage percentage. Never summed with the gap gauge. |
| `gateway_target_unavailable` | gauge | `repo` | emitted | 1 when the App is not installed on the target or it cannot be reached. |
| `gateway_auth_failures_total` | counter | — | emitted | Requests refused before authentication succeeded. Carries no IP label. |
| `gateway_watched_ip_rejected_total` | counter | `ip`, `reason` | emitted | Pre-auth rejections from an IP on observability.watch_ips. |
| `gateway_pre_auth_lru_evicted_total` | counter | — | **declared, not emitted** | Pre-auth IP limiter LRU evictions. Declared in the catalog, not emitted yet; non-zero reopens the fixed-capacity decision. |
| `gateway_workflow_cache_cold_total` | counter | `repo`, `workflow` | emitted | Requests served against a never-fetched workflow definition, so input validation was skipped. |
| `gateway_github_secondary_rate_limit_total` | counter | `installation_id` | emitted | GitHub secondary rate limits observed. Arrives as 403, not 429. |
| `gateway_bootstrap_truncated_total` | counter | `repo` | emitted | Bootstrap history slices cut short by the page cap. |
| `gateway_clock_jump_suspected_total` | counter | — | emitted | Idempotency purges skipped because a forward clock jump was suspected. |
| `gateway_trigger_rejected_total` | counter | `caller`, `reason` | emitted | Authenticated requests refused before reservation. Counted PER REQUEST; the event is coalesced per window for 429s. |
| `gateway_reject_log_dropped_total` | counter | — | emitted | trigger_rejected events that could not be written. The request was still rejected. |
| `gateway_correlation_total` | counter | `correlation` | emitted | Dispatches by correlation armament: what we armed, not what resolved. |
| `gateway_run_link_total` | counter | `resolution`, `resolution_source` | emitted | run_link events by reliability and by the tier that produced them. |
| `gateway_run_name_absent_total` | counter | `repo`, `workflow` | emitted | Correlation tier 2 reached its horizon with a candidate run on the ref, and no candidate carried the injected id. |
| `gateway_correlation_sweep_error_total` | counter | — | emitted | Resolver sweeps that ended in error (correlation tier 3). Unlabelled by design. |
| `gateway_github_dispatch_total` | counter | `repo`, `workflow`, `outcome` | emitted | Outcome of the upstream dispatch CALL. Not the same population as gateway_trigger_total. |
| `gateway_github_quota_paused_total` | counter | `bucket` | emitted | GitHub quota pauses. The only signal that inventory refresh stopped rather than found nothing. |
| `gateway_github_queue_timeout_total` | counter | `lane` | emitted | github.max_queue_wait exceeded, split by lane so a slow caller and a saturated background are distinguishable. |
| `gateway_github_token_refresh_failed_total` | counter | `repo` | emitted | Installation token renewal failed while the old token was still valid — a degradation that looks like success. |

## Histogram buckets

| Metric | Upper bounds (seconds) |
|---|---|
| `gateway_trigger_duration_seconds` | 0.005, 0.01, 0.025, 0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2.5, 5, 10, 30 |
| `gateway_sqlite_write_duration_seconds` | 0.0005, 0.001, 0.0025, 0.005, 0.01, 0.025, 0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 5 |
